# `transform`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
transform(expr, func)
```

Transforms elements in an array using the function.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `lambda_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 2.4.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
SELECT transform(array(1, 2, 3), x -> x + 1);
```

Result:

```text
[2,3,4]
```

```sql
SELECT transform(array(1, 2, 3), (x, i) -> x + i);
```

Result:

```text
[1,3,5]
```
